about.accessibilityBody: Fastline supports VoiceOver and TalkBack, dynamic type up to 130%, high-contrast colours and reduced motion. Every control has a label, and no information relies on colour alone. Tell us about any barrier at jpdash.creator@gmail.com and we will work to fix it.
